bibl.title: Un'antica miscellanea filologica (BKT IX, 66 + P.Berol. inv. 13231G, fr. e = LDAB 5775).
bibl.seg: Menico Caroli, Un'antica miscellanea filologica (BKT IX, 66 + P.Berol. inv. 13231G, fr. e = LDAB 5775).
bibl.note: New edition and commentary of two fragments of papyrus codex, B.K.T. IX, 66 + P. Berol. Inv. 13231G, fr. e (= MP3 2144.1; LDAB 5775), IV-V cent. AD. The text offers an overview of grammatical and literary themes, in question-and-answer format.
